yellow.definition: The color of sunflower petals and lemons; the color obtained by mixing green and red light, or by subtracting blue from white light; the color evoked by light of wavelength around 580 nm; one of the three primary colors in subtractive color systems.

yells.definition: To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yelp.definition: An abrupt, high-pitched noise or utterance.

yeomen.definition: An official providing honorable service in a royal or high noble household, ranking between a squire and a page. Especially, a yeoman of the guard, a member of a ceremonial bodyguard to the UK monarch (not to be confused with a Yeoman Warder).

yeomen’s.definition: An official providing honorable service in a royal or high noble household, ranking between a squire and a page. Especially, a yeoman of the guard, a member of a ceremonial bodyguard to the UK monarch (not to be confused with a Yeoman Warder).

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yesterday.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yielding.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

york.definition: To bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

zymosis.definition: A fermentation; hence, an analogous process by which an infectious disease is believed to be developed.
